diagrams.title: Ontology notation example — product, presentation and substance
diagrams.purpose: Demonstrate OntoUML/UFO-aware stereotype and relation labeling for a small V2 conceptual fragment.
diagrams.generation_method: PlantUML-compatible source; SVG baseline committed with the sample. Future automated export must pin renderer version.
diagrams.alt_text: Illustrative V2 ontology fragment distinguishing Medicinal Product, Medicinal Product Presentation and Pharmaceutical Substance with labeled presentationOf and hasActiveSubstance relations.
diagrams.caption: DGM-ONT-001 — illustrative OntoUML-aware fragment; semantic authority remains the V2 conceptual/formal artifacts.

diagrams.title: V1 to V2 research-evolution lineage
